physical_domains: CPU-to-Bank-5 C2D, export-journal and C2J writes

excluded_domain.name: Attic/HyperRAM session-source cleanup
excluded_domain.reason: not Chip RAM; governed by the separate runtime-overlay DMA-completion contract and not part of the C1 Bank-2/Bank-5 identity claim

hardware_first_red.observation: both physical changes first appeared during the Freezer roundtrip after the rollback header had already been restored

ordering: write C2J ACTIVE and prove that the ACTIVE bookend physically landed before the first transaction mutation
submit transaction mutations without private producer-local completion loops
on publication, run one gathered data barrier that proves every earlier ordered job landed and binds the touched target spans, then content-prove and publish the header
on abort, run one gathered data barrier before export restoration, predecessor-header restoration or any wipe
after successful publication or complete rollback, write C2J CLEAR last and prove that the CLEAR bookend physically landed before scratch release or another transaction

completion.definition: target content equals the independently held expected content
completion.readback_rule: the readback destination is disjoint from the write source, is poisoned unequal exactly once, receives exactly one ordered trailing target read, and is then sampled locally without re-poison or read resubmission until equality or timeout

implementation.ABI: mode in A, length in A, Z=0 on return
implementation.permanent_gate: the final ELF must contain exactly one sized function and exactly four direct C-to-ASM edges; disappearance, inlining, an unknown edge, a mutable load or a retry bypass is red

retry_length_authority.producer: none: the completion mode fully determines the admitted content domain
retry_length_authority.consumer: rematerialize the mode-derived constant immediately before the one poison pass, before the one target DMA, and before every local target comparison
forbidden: retaining transfer length solely in llvm-mos __rc scratch across c2_stream_c2d_read
using c2_append_state.record[27] or any other phase-scratch byte as a retry-length authority
accepting a caller-supplied length that can disagree with the completion mode
re-poisoning the observed buffer or resubmitting the target read on a timeout retry
hardware_first_reds: Link 62 entered with $0040, retried with live scratch $bb04 and never reached the 64-frame timeout boundary
Link 63 reloaded record[27] as its alleged authority, but hardware observed $fc while the C2J call contract required $40; Slot 39 remained ACTIVE before Cutpoint 3

the first Link 64 WPLTO source form called an always-inline helper four times, but whole-program LTO removed the symbol, kept length live in $1a across c2_stream_c2d_read and sent the retry edge directly back to poison

the Link 64 product form re-poisoned and resubmitted on every retry; a read delivered after the immediate comparison was erased before the next comparison, reproducing good target content before and after a 64-frame timeout

completion.ordering_witness: one content-proven read submitted after the transaction writes dominates every earlier job submitted through the same ordered DMA engine; its Bank-0 destination is observed locally until delivery and is never overwritten or resubmitted while pending

granularity.rule: The two data barriers are amortized transaction boundaries. C2J ACTIVE and CLEAR are independent journal bookends protecting recoverability and are not folded into the data-barrier count.

C2J_identity_seal.format_crc: The existing CRC32/IEEE in C2J bytes 60..63 remains the recovery-format integrity field.
C2J_identity_seal.bookend_crc: CRC16/CCITT-FALSE over all 64 final emitted C2J bytes, including the format CRC32.
C2J_identity_seal.producer_rule: The journal producer computes the bookend seal once after all fields and the format CRC32 are final and before submitting ACTIVE.
C2J_identity_seal.recovery_rule: The journal validator checks the format CRC32 and all recovery bounds first, then binds the same CRC16 seal from the validated 64-byte snapshot before reconstruction or rollback.
C2J_identity_seal.consumer_rule: The common ACTIVE/rollback bookend poll computes one target CRC16 with the existing rtov_crc_mem assembler leaf and compares it with the bound seal; rebuilding and comparing the twenty producer fields is forbidden.
C2J_identity_seal.scratch_lifetime: The source-record CRC phase is complete before the seal is written; bytes 25..26 remain unowned through ACTIVE, publication or rollback and are released only after a content-proven CLEAR.

boundary_amortization.pre_header: one common cold body drains all pre-publication Bank-2/Bank-5 jobs, observes the target identities of the touched spans and proves the header before committed/runtime publication
boundary_amortization.pre_rollback: the same common cold body drains all forward jobs before the first restoration or wipe
boundary_amortization.C2J_ACTIVE: must be independently content-converged and match its producer-bound CRC16 seal before mutation; otherwise an abort can find no usable journal
boundary_amortization.C2J_CLEAR: must be independently content-converged last; otherwise stale ACTIVE can survive into the next transaction or a late zero can erase its new ACTIVE
boundary_amortization.implementation_rule: one transported cold body serves all four modes and is invoked serially by the resident driver; overlays never call overlays
boundary_amortization.producer_rule: producer and cleanup phases submit writes and maintain only bounded touched-span facts; poison/readback/timeout machinery is never materialized per producer or per block

quiescent_state.bank2_aborted_suffix: all zero, byteidentical to the pre-append suffix
quiescent_state.bank5_export_scratch: all zero outside an active append transaction
quiescent_state.bank5_c2d_suffix: byteidentical to the pre-append image/entry/resolution/root suffix
quiescent_state.bank5_c2j: all zero, cleared after every other restoration

active_product_write_inventory.disposition: plain ordered writes; one gathered pre-header target proof replaces per-block convergence

active_product_write_inventory.producer: c2_append_image_phase, c2_append_entries_phase and decoder resolution/root writers
active_product_write_inventory.disposition: plain ordered writes; the gathered pre-header barrier and independently verified final header dominate publication
independent target convergence before c2_runtime/committed publication
plain ordered writes; pre-header completion covers plan construction and the success/rollback tail bookend covers its later compaction and clearing

active_product_write_inventory.producer: intern through sympool_write, nameoff_set and symval_set
active_product_write_inventory.target: Bank 5 symbol pool, name-offset and value domains
active_product_write_inventory.disposition: included in the gathered pre-header ordered-job barrier; no private symbol-table completion path

active_product_write_inventory.target: Bank 5 export rollback records and symbol-function cells
active_product_write_inventory.disposition: plain ordered writes; pre-rollback barrier dominates restoration and C2J CLEAR is the successful-publication tail fence
emit the format CRC32, bind one CRC16 seal over the final 64-byte record in free phase scratch, then independently converge the target and compare one leaf-computed seal before ACTIVE

active_product_write_inventory.target: Bank 5 restored symbol-function cells and predecessor header
active_product_write_inventory.disposition: may begin only after the gathered pre-rollback barrier; completion is amortized into the final CLEAR bookend

active_product_write_inventory.target: Bank 2 code suffix and Bank 5 C2D suffix
active_product_write_inventory.disposition: plain ordered restoration writes after the pre-rollback barrier; C2J CLEAR is the final completion fence
export scratch zero first, C2J zero last, then the shared cold body proves the CLEAR bookend before bookkeeping is cleared
not a rollback booking and never verified against its own source; later disjoint consumer read remains separately gate-visible

blind_readback_inventory.rule: a disjoint buffer is necessary but not sufficient; it is poisoned and sampled until content convergence or timeout

fixtures.cutpoint4_late_write_interleaving: late Bank-2 and export-journal writes must be drained before rollback; deleting the fence recreates 9+2 physical residue
fixtures.exact_abort_restoration: Bank-2 suffix, Bank-5 C2D suffix, export scratch, predecessor header and C2J match their quiescent baseline byte-for-byte
fixtures.same_buffer_negative: aliasing expected and observed is rejected
fixtures.timeout_negative: a target that never converges returns the specific IO failure without publishing or clearing C2J
fixtures.ACTIVE_removed: mutation before a converged ACTIVE bookend is rejected
fixtures.pre_header_barrier_removed: header or committed publication with an outstanding Bank-2/Bank-5 write is rejected
fixtures.pre_rollback_barrier_removed: restoration or wipe with an outstanding forward write reproduces the Cutpoint-4 residue and is rejected
fixtures.CLEAR_removed: return or scratch reuse before a converged CLEAR bookend is rejected
fixtures.private_loop_regression: producer-local poison/readback/timeout loops are rejected; the shared cold body is the sole general completion implementation
fixtures.C2J_target_corruption: changing any tested target byte after emission breaks the bound bookend seal
fixtures.C2J_seal_corruption: changing the phase-scratch seal fails closed before ACTIVE or rollback
fixtures.C2J_recovery_reseal_removed: a validated recovery record without a newly bound seal cannot enter rollback
fixtures.C2J_seal_before_format_crc: binding the seal before bytes 60..63 are final is rejected
fixtures.C2J_field_reconstruction_regression: reintroducing the twenty-field comparison into the common poll is rejected
fixtures.retry_length_scratch_clobber: deliberately changing call scratch from $0040 to $bb04 after the nested read must not change the mode-derived retry length or hide the timeout boundary
fixtures.retry_length_record_clobber: deliberately changing record[27] to $fc before and after the nested read must be semantically inert; the linked poll must not read or write that byte
fixtures.retry_length_mode_domain: C2J modes rematerialize 64 and Publish rematerializes 48 before the one poison pass, the one target DMA and every local comparison; unknown modes fail closed
fixtures.retry_read_self_poison: a one-attempt-late read result must survive into the next comparison; moving poison or c2_stream_c2d_read inside the timeout retry loop is rejected

capacity.placement_rule: the one general completion body is a cold transported phase driven by the resident serial driver; producer and cleanup overlays contain no private convergence machinery; the resident C2D write seam and E000 geometry remain byteidentical

claim_limit: A green host/WPLTO probe proves contract shape, the linked non-LTO stateless length derivation, placement and capacity only. C1 remains OPEN until Cutpoints 3 and 4 are repeated on hardware against a successor product identity.
